translation_status: No vetted English stanza translation supplied; translation_en remains empty. Caption commentary is not presented as translation.
caption_policy: Caption prose is preserved verbatim as commentary_en for the stanza whose #N label it carries. Formatting-only cleanup: trailing whitespace removed, a Facebook "… See more" truncation marker removed (the stanza is then flagged truncated), and appended non-English material that follows the English commentary (Tamil translation, song lyrics or chants) is left out of commentary_en but kept verbatim in the caption file.

9.text: Devas and divine Gods were happy and praised Krishna as the protector of Righteousness or Dharma on the earth by killing Arishtasuran.
9.source: Facebook group read-back of 2026-11-27 (missing-stanza search); the download index's stanza value for this picture was empty or wrong

earlier_caption.text: The force with which the evil-minded asura fell dead, few trees in the forest fell and destroyed the forest. Devas watching the sight from heaven were so pleased and showered flowers on Krishna.
earlier_caption.note: Caption the first download pass recorded for this picture (formerly unplaced); it describes Arishta's fall and the Devas' flowers, so it is kept with stanza 9 after the current caption.
